Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: soft rectangular face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: shaved temple geometry. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; a hand-painted hem mark. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
